correctness.rationale: PASS applies to the corrected claim only. The original joint assertion at frozen RESULT.md line 9 is false: it identified the 720 degree-13 bases with the 720 eccentricity-seven bases from equal marginal totals. Both frozen verifiers report only separate marginals. In the fresh reconstruction, list duads and partitions, compute all 30 vertex distance rows and take the minimum over edge endpoints. A subset is resolving iff its separation masks cover all 990 edge pairs. Exhaustion of all subsets of sizes 1–5 gives 0,0,0,0,4560, split 2280/2280 between duad counts two and three. The empty set is impossible by definition. Construct adjacency by legal replacement and independently by pairwise symmetric difference two; the result has 37320 edges. BFS by bitset frontiers and by queues from every basis agrees source by source, reaches all 4560 each time, and confirms radius 6, diameter 7 and 360 unordered distance-seven pairs. The true joint bins (degree, eccentricity):count are (13,6):720, (17,6):3120, (17,7):720 and (13,7):0. The corrected proof collects both attributes at each BFS source. The added deterministic certificate checker independently builds the same exchange relation via common four-subset buckets and compares the full supplied edge and diametral-pair lists; its computed joint bins match the fresh from-definition replay. All finite bounds, labelling and minimum-only token jumps are unchanged.
residual_risks: Exhaustive finite computational evidence, not a proof-assistant certificate or expert attestation. The added bucket-based checker starts from the basis certificate; basis completeness is verified separately by the fresh reconstruction and frozen algorithms.

value.rationale: The cubic eight-cage is a canonical small incidence graph, and the minimum edge-distinguishing landmark count and ability to reconfigure optima without extra landmarks are natural precise questions. The result supplies a full count and type split, a sharp worst-case exchange bound, and the corrected nonuniformity: all sparse-degree bases are central, while peripheral bases belong to the higher-degree class. This joint characterization is meaningful and is not determined by either marginal or by ordinary vertex basis results.
residual_risks: The census has value for this fixed canonical graph; it does not warrant an application performance claim or a general reconfiguration theorem.
